description: This file contains functions and types for setting up and mocking booking scenarios in a testing environment, including creating event types, bookings, users, webhooks, workflows, and related entities in a Prisma mock database.

methods.name: addHostsToDb
methods.description: Creates host groups, hosts, and host locations in the mock database based on provided event types.

methods.name: addEventTypesToDb
methods.description: Creates event types, schedules, restriction schedules, and teams in the mock database, and links related entities.

methods.name: addEventTypes
methods.description: Prepares and adds event types with associated users, hosts, and related data to the database.

methods.name: addBookingReferencesToDB
methods.description: Creates multiple booking references in the mock database.

methods.name: addBookingsToDb
methods.description: Creates bookings in the mock database, ensuring date consistency.

methods.name: addBookings
methods.description: Prepares booking data, including references and attendees, and adds bookings to the database.

methods.name: addWebhooksToDb
methods.description: Creates webhook entries in the mock database.

methods.name: addPaymentToDb
methods.description: Creates payment entries in the mock database.

methods.name: addWebhooks
methods.description: Prepares and adds webhook data to the database.

methods.name: addWorkflowsToDb
methods.description: Creates workflows and associated steps, and links them to teams or event types.

methods.name: addWorkflows
methods.description: Prepares workflow data and adds workflows to the database.

methods.name: addWorkflowReminders
methods.description: Creates workflow reminder entries in the database.

methods.name: addUsersToDb
methods.description: Creates user entries, including credentials, schedules, teams, and related data, in the mock database.

methods.name: addTeamsToDb
methods.description: Creates or updates team entries in the mock database.

methods.name: addUsers
methods.description: Prepares user data, including nested entities, and adds users to the database.

methods.name: createBookingScenario
methods.description: Sets up a complete booking scenario with users, event types, bookings, webhooks, workflows, and other related entities.

methods.name: createOrganization
methods.description: Creates an organization and optionally a team within it in the mock database.

methods.name: createCredentials
methods.description: Creates credential entries in the mock database.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Computes a date with optional increments for day, month, and year, mainly for testing purposes.
